image_description: A male mallard duck (drake) floating on dark, rippling water. The duck is captured in a preening pose with its head turned back towards its wing/tail area. It displays characteristic breeding plumage: an iridescent green head, a distinct white neck ring, and a mottled brown/grey body. A blue speculum patch with white borders is visible on the raised wing. The bill is yellow-green with a black tip, and a dark eye is visible on the side of the head.
